review_candidates.description: Company Description Self-employed Quran teachers provide personalized, learner-centered instruction tailored to individual needs and goals. The work environment typically involves small group or one-on-one sessions, allowing for focused attention on each learner’s recitation and understanding. Teachers manage their own schedules, teaching methods, and materials, creating a flexible yet structured learning experience. This role emphasizes ethical conduct, respect for diverse learners, and a commitment to high standards of education. Role Description The Quran Teacher will provide full-time, on-site instruction in Al Wakrah, focusing on accurate recitation, tajweed, and understanding of Quranic text appropriate to each learner’s level. Day-to-day tasks include planning and delivering structured lessons, assessing learner progress, and providing regular feedback and support. The role involves preparing teaching materials, organizing practice sessions, and maintaining a calm, respectful classroom environment. The teacher will communicate regularly with learners and, where applicable, with families or guardians to discuss goals, progress, and areas for improvement. The position requires consistent punctuality, adherence to agreed teaching schedules, and ongoing development of teaching methods. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong Teaching and Training skills to deliver effective Quran lessons and support diverse learning styles. Candidates should possess solid Lesson Planning abilities and Education-related experience to design structured, progressive learning programs. Candidates should possess clear Communication skills to explain concepts, provide feedback, and interact respectfully with learners and families. Strong knowledge of Quranic recitation, tajweed rules, and basic Arabic reading skills. Prior experience teaching the Quran to children, youth, or adults is highly beneficial. Ability to maintain a respectful, inclusive, and culturally sensitive learning environment. Reliability in maintaining full-time on-site schedules in Al Wakrah and managing multiple learners effectively.
